application_conditions: 'Apply now' → Impact sign-up (https://app.impact.com/campaign-promo-signup/Bitpanda1649085811694.brand). Support FAQ: register with the same e-mail as your Bitpanda user account; send the exact link where you plan to promote; an Affiliate Manager reviews and e-mails approval; panel inside the Bitpanda account. No website required (social channels accepted). Restrictions: no PPC on search engines; German affiliates may not refer German residents; Affiliate and Tell-a-Friend are mutually exclusive (2026-11-04).
paid_action: 'Commission for every referred user' — qualifying action not defined publicly.

commission.model_note: CPA and revenue-share options depending on traffic source (affiliate page, no rates); support FAQ states 'up to 20% revenue share' on referred customers' purchases. Card not named as a commissionable action.

rules_note: FAQ headings mention PPC and country restrictions but answers were not retrievable.

evidence.title: Bitpanda Affiliate Programme FAQ (support)
evidence.excerpt: Up to 20% revenue share on referred customers' purchases, paid to the default Bitpanda fiat wallet before the end of the following month; cookie tracking; no card mention; German affiliates cannot refer German residents.

notes: Terms must be read inside Impact after application; nothing more is public. 2026-11-04: requires a Bitpanda user account under the same e-mail; a German-resident affiliate could not monetise German visitors — check David's entity country before applying.
